name: coding-agent
description: Takes a Technical Design Document (PDF) and raises Pull Requests implementing it — one PR per affected service, never auto-merged.

triggers.name: uploaded_files
triggers.description: The Technical Design Document to implement, as a PDF.

triggers.name: base_branch_by_service
triggers.description: Optional JSON object mapping service name to the PR's base branch, e.g. {"orders": "develop"}. Omit to use each service's manifest branch or repo default.
